cumulative_call_accounting_across_all_si.note: This is historical accounting of the already-authorized fresh six-ticker production run set, not calls made during this closure task (which made zero).

issue_1_six_ticker_regression_results.summary: regression_report_v3.json now populated from all six FINAL_FRESH_SELECTED runs, showing actual detected Alphas/main conflicts (not just expected labels) per ticker. Ticker consistency 6/6, artifact completeness 6/6, graph-edges gate 6/6.
issue_1_six_ticker_regression_results.limitation: main_conflict_gold_status = NOT_GOLD_EVALUABLE -- zero of the referenced main-conflict expectations across all six tickers carry APPROVED_GOLD authority, so the >=4/6 acceptance gate is not evaluable against a frozen Golden benchmark. This is a benchmark-authority gap, not a pipeline defect: the pipeline produced a plausible, structurally-sound main conflict for 4 of 6 tickers (NVDA/QQQ/TSM/AMD admitted; MSFT/SNDK correctly found zero admitted conflict after evaluating all 6 declared pairs each).

issue_2_evidence_review_formal_accuracy_.summary: Already John-approved: alpha_match_accuracy=83% (166/200), polarity_accuracy=85.25% (52/61), critical_support_opposition_reversal_count=0. Unchanged and reconfirmed this closure -- this metric is a fixed, already-reviewed sample and does not get recomputed per fresh run.

issue_3_entity_exposure_seed_status_cons.summary: All six final selected runs show a single canonical seed status ('approved_gating') consistently across current_seed_status/seed_approval_status/mode/enforcement_allowed, and the seed_status_consistency accounting invariant (entity_exposure_audit.current_seed_status == _current_seed_status(ticker)) passes on all six. No conflicting status aliases found.

issue_4_alpha_level_alignment.summary: B4 thresholds unchanged (ACTIVE=50.0, DOMINANT=70.0, REGIME_LEVEL=86.0). NO_TICKER_SPECIFIC_EVIDENCE/NO_LOCAL_STRUCTURE_SUPPORT gate code unchanged. A301 shows real, varied levels across the six runs (dominant/active/candidate) with no cap_reasons falsely suppressing or falsely inflating any run -- no A301 display regression found.

issue_5_evidence_polarity.summary: conflict_detector.py's stance-filtered bull_display_qualifying/bear_display_qualifying fix is unchanged in code. Spot-checked NVDA's admitted main conflict (A101 bull side / A304 bear side) -- structurally correct polarity, no inversion. Critical support/opposition reversal count remains 0 (Issue 2's fixed sample).

issue_6_feedback_loop_proof.summary: Final Alpha Memory feedback-loop proof built from all six FINAL_FRESH_SELECTED runs. End-to-end chain proved: persisted historical runs -> stable atomic edge phi identity -> exact cross-run matching -> recurrence observation -> run_audit/API visibility. NVDA shows the strongest example (4 recurring relations, 9 prior observations). Explicitly remains SHADOW / audit-only: activation_modulation_applied=false (hardcoded), lifecycle=MODEL 0, no invalidation/expiry/failed/non-execution modulation implemented anywhere.

high_value_recovery_recheck.summary: Re-ran the primary mechanical discovery diagnostic (candidate_scores[*].eligible==true despite no_match) against the fresh six-run set: 200 candidates found, every one individually read (not sampled). Result: 0 strong, 1 borderline (SNDK A103 analogy-rejection), 199 correct_none. Confirms, on genuinely fresh data, the same conclusion reached before: the target of >=20 recoverable high-value unclassified claims is not supported by the healthy semantic pipeline's actual output.
high_value_recovery_recheck.unavailable_pool_check: Fresh unavailable rate (1.02%, 47/4601) vs historical Step5A baseline (0.80%, 39/4894) -- no demonstrable improvement from the alpha_mapper.py batch-size/concurrency repair; difference is within normal run-to-run provider-load variance.

conflict_state_separation.summary: admitted/candidate(suppressed)/rejected remain structurally distinct across all six runs. conflict_pairs_conserved (declared == admitted+suppressed+rejected) and candidate_conflicts_are_a_subset_of_suppressed accounting invariants both pass on all six.
